text:
Sam: Quick follow-up on INC-901 postmortem actions. I pulled the action list from the doc — can folks please confirm owners and firm due dates? Trying to close this out before Friday EOD.
Mira: I can own the 'prometheus alert tuning' task. Targeting Tue 03/23 EOD. Will update the runbook once done. :white_check_mark:
Jose: I’ll take the 'rollback test harness' work. ETA Wed 03/24 morning. Need a 2-hour window on staging to validate.
Priya: I own 'access log retention + export' — aiming for Thu 03/25. Ping me if you need schema details.
Alex: Re: rollback test — @Jose please note eng-infra needs to enable the ephemeral job queue (it's a dependency). I can schedule the infra change tomorrow, but need an owner to run the tests.
Jose: @Alex thanks — please put the infra change in the infra-runbook channel. I can run tests once it's available.
Tasha: I can do the 'alert paging cadence' doc update. Will push PR by Wed 03/24. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/alerting/pulls/42
Sam: Awesome — two quick asks: 1) can each owner paste the exact due date (YYYY-MM-DD) so I can mark them in the postmortem doc? 2) If any task blocks on another team, call it out now so we can escalate.
Mira: 2026-03-23. Blockers: none.
Jose: 2026-03-24. Blockers: infra queue change from @Alex.
Priya: 2026-03-25. Blockers: need sample logs from @Tasha to validate export script.
Alex: Infra change scheduled 2026-03-22 10:00-11:00 PT. I'll post the change link in eng-infra once live. No other blockers.
Tasha: PR created and assigned to @Priya for review. PR link above. ETA for review: 2026-03-24.
Sam: incident-bot — can you add a reminder on 2026-03-24 for any outstanding actions?
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z for thread INC-901 actions. :bell:
Priya: Noted — I will fetch logs from the retention job after @Tasha's PR merges and aim to finish on 2026-03-25.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem doc with these owners/dates and ping the exec channel once closure is near. If anyone's dates slip, please update this thread so we can reassign if needed. :pray:
